summary_1line: Lakshmana consoles grief-stricken Rama after Sita’s abduction, urging courage, reason, and determined search rather than despair or destructive rage.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lakshmana kneels beside the despairing Rama in the forest, holding his feet and pleading with him to rise from grief.
Rama sits collapsed in anguish among trees and scattered signs of battle while Lakshmana speaks firmly beside him with bow in hand.
Lakshmana gestures toward the wild forest as he vows they will search oceans, mountains, caves, and lakes to find Sita’s captor.
